entities.summary: Eduardo José Cabra Martínez, better known by his stage name "Visitante Calle 13", "Visitante", or more recently, "Cabra", is a Puerto Rican producer, musician, composer, and multi-instrumentalist. He rose to fame in the Puerto Rican band Calle 13, which he co-founded with his step brother René Pérez Joglar (Residente).
